title: Healey signs executive order requiring new data centers to get local approval before development
author: Annie Jonas
bullets: Local News Under the order, the state cannot advance permits projects unless developers have filed a community benefits agreement.
Drone image of the Markley Group data center alongside a residential neighborhood on May 12, 2026 in Lowell.

(Danielle Parhizkaran/Globe Staff) Governor Maura Healey signed an executive order Tuesday that bars state agencies from issuing permits to large data center projects unless the developer has first received approval from the community, the latest step to rein in an industry that has drawn mounting local opposition across Massachusetts.
